role: Assess threat-model.v3.json#V10.requiredResolution item by item against the artifacts that are actually independently reviewed today, and record what each item does and does not close. This is an architecture assessment. It applies nothing, seals nothing, freezes nothing, signs nothing and selects no retention default. It is written to be consumable by the evidence-gated T12 guard in check-threat-claims.py if and only if a later authority applies the deferred integration patch recorded below, and the preconditions of that patch are NOT met today.

authority.rule: An architecture disposition may cite a product decision and may never constitute one. The binding packet is the only place a product decision is constituted. This artifact was written after IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE section 4.4, which records that a fabricated retention sign-off survived three days in this corpus because an architecture candidate asserted what only the binding packet may carry.

verdict.disposition: PARTIAL — V10 IS NOT RESOLVED BY THIS ARTIFACT
verdict.statement: Item 1 is discharged with residuals against independently reviewed bytes at architecture-candidate grade. Item 2 is partially discharged: the retained verification/regeneration closure and the per-Run custody policy are both selected and bound in independently reviewed bytes, but the durable default posture is UNSELECTED and is not an architecture choice to make. Item 3 is NOT DISCHARGED: the property is stated in bytes that passed independent review, but that review examined none of the keys carrying it, no retained checker evaluates it, the one checker that ever derived it belongs to an independently rejected artifact, and the freeze itself still lists purge semantics that do not rewrite a sealed Run as a mandatory unmet insertion. Because one of three required items is open, V10 remains open and the status-changing half of the deferred patch is NOT authorised.
verdict.whyThisIsNotAPaperSeal: No discharge below rests on an implementable claim, a self-declared status, or a checker exit code alone. Each names a reviewed artifact, its recomputed SHA-256, the review that judged those exact bytes, and the specific structural position that carries the obligation. Where the reviewed bytes carry the words but the review did not read them, that is recorded as NOT DISCHARGED rather than as a discharge.

whatTheBriefNamedAndWhatItActuallyIs.finding: evaluation-proof.v13 does NOT cover item 1 and cannot discharge it. Its claimId is CD-RT-5, not EVIDENCE, and its declared role is repairing the two blocking findings of the v11 review about answer provenance and guard-tamper enumeration. Measured over its bytes: zero occurrences of no-match, zero of exactActivation, two of relationship and seven of outcome, against 59, 21 and 56 respectively in evaluation-proof.v8. The claim-shape coverage was present through v9 and dropped at v10; v10 through v13 carry none of it while each declaring supersedesProofObligationsOf its immediate predecessor, so the head of the evaluation-proof chain declares supersession of obligations whose content it does not carry. The corpus resolves this its own way and correctly: evidence.v10, the binding EVIDENCE artifact, deliberately pins evaluation-proof.v8 rather than the chain head.

That is a real and independently adjudicated property. It is not item 1's property, and citing it as item 1's discharge would be a category error.

residualsCarriedForwardFromTheCitedRevie.summary: The reviewer built a FOURTH means of distinguishing an observed call from an unobserved one, in the same class and by the same means as the candidate's own published escape — the ledger-entry-count signal, comparing no binding at all. The reviewer's instance SB-MD6 routes the VALIDATION VERDICT, the commitment AND the preimage, 7 of 7 each, to check-c2.py, with exit 0, a banner byte-identical to the honest run's, and a selftest that prints SELFTEST-PASS. The verdict is the accept/reject gate. The candidate's own published escape substitutes only a commitment, so a reader pricing the residual from the published text underprices it. The reviewer records this as the sharpest observation in the review and the one a successor should act on first.
residualsCarriedForwardFromTheCitedRevie.whyNonBlocking: The published scope statement is general and covers the class, and the escape set is declared as a measurement over instances rather than as an enumeration. Nothing published is falsified. The gap is disclosure severity, not truth.
residualsCarriedForwardFromTheCitedRevie.effectOnThisDischarge: It does not weaken item 1, because item 1 is discharged against evaluation-proof.v8 and evidence.v10, not against v13. It is carried here in full because a disposition that cited v13's PASS without carrying it would be exactly the paper seal this corpus keeps catching.

residualsCarriedForwardFromTheCitedRevie.summary: The scope self-scan tokenises on whitespace only, so the predecessor's own rejected sentence can be reintroduced with a comma or parentheses and is not flagged. More fundamentally the refusal is name-based and cannot detect narrowing at all: the reviewer wrote a scope naming no variant that is the predecessor's false boundary in substance, and the run is green. The phrase 'refuses it structurally rather than by intention' is an overclaim.

answerProvenance.independentPathIsUnreachable is FALSE by measurement. After one heavy run, seventy-five private module instances remain in sys.modules, including the anchor and the reference; sys.modules is neither the guard's frame nor a server's closure cell, so the reader's exclusion set is incomplete. Non-blocking because the field is unenforced and unprinted, the introspection tripwire catches the cheap spellings, and the reviewer could not turn the reachability into an escape.

assurance.nonClaims and guardInventory.whatNoGuardHereCovers appear nowhere in the retained checker, so both are unverified prose in a document whose thesis is that a prose assertion is not a record. They carry the predecessor's narrow framing and two stale counts — twenty-five built classes where the enforced number is twenty-nine — and one wrong cross-reference. The reviewer considered this as a blocker and rejected it because the enforced banner-printed scope carries an override clause that binds the document.

A residual whose anchors are intact but whose surrounding prose contradicts them passes green. Forty-six of one hundred ninety-eight float/bool cases are rejected by a whole-block comparison whose message names the block rather than the leaf, so a future auditor grepping finding text will not find those leaves named. No case escapes.

Recorded in the candidate's favour: the exactly-one-witness-record rule makes the obvious strengthening of the published escape impossible, forcing the reviewer's own attack onto a strictly more fragile positional signal. The design is doing work neither the scope nor the published residual claims credit for.
Environment and reproduction. CPython 3.14.6, Darwin 25.5.0 arm64, python3 -I -B, stdlib only, no timeout binary on this host.

requiredResolutionAssessment.obligation: Select the retained verification/regeneration closure and a per-Run custody policy before durable authoritative Runs are enabled

whatIsSelectedAndBound.verbatim: frozen evidence or exact deterministic regeneration closure is selected per proof obligation
whatIsSelectedAndBound.assessment: SELECTED. The choice between retaining frozen evidence and retaining a deterministic regeneration closure is made per proof obligation rather than globally, which is what the obligation asks for. The closure itself is structurally bound: SemanticCapabilityClosureV3 requires schemaVersion, projectId, sealedCapability, semanticObjectBindings, semanticRoots, proofRefs, dependencyEdges, units and closureCommitment, with a closed forbidden list, and evidence.v10 pins its CAS ref and commitment by digest.

whatIsSelectedAndBound.verbatim: orchestration host applies an explicit project policy; producers never select custody
whatIsSelectedAndBound.assessment: SELECTED. Custody selection is host-resolved and never producer-selected. This is the authority direction reviewer-3 required when the rejected predecessor inverted it.

whatIsNotSelectedAndWhyThisLaneCannotSel.assessment: The default durable-custody posture remains unselected and this disposition does not select it. The candidate records a recommendation — no managed durable user-derived write without an explicit project storage and retention policy, and advisory or ephemeral only when policy is missing — and correctly leaves it as a recommendation. An architecture lane has no standing to turn a recommendation into a decision, which is precisely the mechanism IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE section 4.4 records as having failed once already.
whatIsNotSelectedAndWhyThisLaneCannotSel.consequence: Item 2's clause 'before durable authoritative Runs are enabled' is satisfied only in the trivial direction: durable authoritative Runs are not enabled. retention-tiers.v22 $.integrationState records G19 blocked, and the same block records this finding open. The obligation is therefore partially discharged, not discharged.

invariants.assert: A discharge names a real artifact, its SHA-256 as recomputed at authoring time, the review that judged those exact bytes, and the structural position carrying the obligation. An implementable claim, a self-declared status, or a green checker exit is never a discharge.
A review verdict covers only what the review read. Where reviewed bytes carry an obligation that the review did not examine, the obligation is NOT DISCHARGED, however clean the verdict.

Declared text is not evaluated text. Where a retained checker protects a sentence by byte equality but never computes whether the sentence is true, the sentence is recorded as declared and the obligation it carries is not closed by it.
This finding may be recorded resolved only when all three of its required items are discharged. One open item leaves the finding open, and no aggregate of the other two substitutes for it.

This artifact may cite a product decision and may never constitute one. No retention default, durable posture or product acceptance is selected, implied or advanced here, and the pending retention decision remains blocked exactly as the binding packet records it.

Nothing here signs, seals, freezes, applies or integrates. Every status this artifact touches stays CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED and DO-NOT-SEAL, and the deferred integration patch is a specification of an edit, never the edit.

An artifact whose declared claim differs from the obligation under assessment cannot discharge that obligation, however clean its own review. Subject drift inside a version chain is measured, not inferred from the filename.

Every residual carried by a review this disposition cites is reproduced here at its own severity, including the ones that make the citation weaker. A discharge that omits the sharpest residual of the review it rests on is a paper seal.

observations.observation: T12 reads no numeric leaf of this artifact. It reads claimId as a string comparison and tests invariants, counterexampleFixtures.fixtures and retainedResiduals for truthiness only. Every integer this artifact publishes — version, item numbers, counts — is therefore inert to check-threat-claims.py, and no float or bool respelling of any of them can change its verdict.
observations.measured: Exhaustive, nothing sampled. This artifact carries 15 integer leaves. Each was replaced, one at a time, by its float equivalent, and each whose value is 0 or 1 was additionally replaced by the corresponding bool: 25 respellings in total. Each mutated copy was materialised in the scratch farm and driven through the unmodified gate against the patched base. T12 V10 findings: ZERO in 25 of 25.
observations.readCorrectly: This is not a claim that this artifact is guarded against numeric drift. It is the opposite: the gate does not look, so nothing here is guarded by it. A consumer that does read these numbers must guard them itself.

observations.observation: T12 accepts any non-empty string as a discharge status. A discharge recording status NOT DISCHARGED, with a valid by citation, passes the gate exactly as one recording DISCHARGED does. The gate enforces that a discharge exists and is sourced; it does not enforce that the discharge succeeded.
observations.measured: A resolution carrying three discharges, every one of them with status 'NOT DISCHARGED' and a valid by citation, was driven through the unmodified gate: 0 T12 V10 findings. The gate reports the finding closed against three admitted failures.
observations.consequence: The gate cannot by itself stop this finding being recorded resolved against three honestly-failing discharges. That judgement is the reviewer's and the signer's, which is why invariant VD-4 is stated here in words rather than left to the checker.

observations.observation: T12 resolves the disposition artifact by basename only — it takes pathlib.Path(art).name and joins it under artifacts/. A resolution citing a path in any other directory resolves to the same file, so the directory component of dispositionArtifact is not load-bearing and cannot be relied on to distinguish two dispositions of the same name.
